task_definition.task_description: Please get the current UTC time, retrieve the snapshot of the living room light, and check the payload for the bedroom light. Next, find the discovered lock ticket in the living room and archive it for admin_user_01 via the app with medium priority, using the current UTC time as the title. Finally, take a snapshot of the workspace at /opt/iot/workspace using the lock ticket's ID as the backup name, and send a high-priority email alert to admin_user_01.

user_input.query: Could you please get the current time in UTC? Once you have that, retrieve the snapshot for the living room light, which is light_living, and check the payload for the bedroom light, light_bedroom. Next, find the discovered lock ticket in the living_room. I need you to archive this ticket for admin_user_01 via the app with medium priority, using the current UTC time as the title. After that, take a snapshot of the workspace at /opt/iot/workspace using the lock ticket's ID as the backup name. Finally, send a high-priority email alert to admin_user_01.
